title: Minimum Cost to Connect Ropes
statement_html:
Given the lengths of several ropes, connect all of them into one rope. Connecting two ropes costs the sum of their lengths. Return the minimum total cost.

Input: the first line has n; the second line has the n rope lengths.

Output: the minimum total cost.

Example 1:

Input:
4
4 3 2 6
Output: 29
Explanation:
Connect 2 + 3 = 5   -> ropes [4, 5, 6]
Connect 4 + 5 = 9   -> ropes [6, 9]
Connect 6 + 9 = 15  -> ropes [15]
Total = 5 + 9 + 15 = 29

Example 2:

Input:
1
7
Output: 0
Explanation: There is already one rope.

Constraints:

  • 1 <= n <= 105

  • 1 <= ropeLength[i] <= 104 (the total cost needs 64 bits)

This is LeetCode #1167 Minimum Cost to Connect Sticks (premium), so the statement here is written from the DomJudge PDF.
